title: Human Resources Director Brazil
description:
At Diaverum , we are looking for a business-oriented and hands-on HR Director to lead our HR function in Brazil. This role is critical in attracting, developing, and retaining top talent while ensuring a positive, inclusive, and compliant work environment.

Everyone deserves a fulfilling life. That’s why we’re dedicated to enhancing the lives of renal patients.

As a global leader and the largest independent renal service provider in Europe, we have 13,000 healthcare professionals caring for around 41,000 patients across 450 clinics in 24 countries globally . We provide renal care personalized to patients’ needs and choices, offering a portfolio of treatments ranging from preventive care, hemodialysis, peritoneal dialysis and home care, to the coordination of patients’ comorbidities and holiday dialysis.

Our vision is to transform renal care, delivering and broadening access to the highest quality of kidney care for patients around the world . At the heart of what we do is our standardized care delivery model, continuously evolving digital & AI infrastructure and people caring for patients with competence, passion and inspiration.

Headquartered in Malmö, Sweden, Diaverum is part of the M42 group of companies , a first-of-its-kind integrated health powerhouse committed to the sustainable future of health.

Diaverum Brazil ranks first in the number of patients within the Diaverum group and is the second-largest player in the Brazilian market. The company provides renal services through its own clinics and as a third-party provider for hospitals, treating 4,500 chronic patients across 12 clinics, performing 75,000 treatments per month. Headquartered in São Paulo, its clinics are located in the São Paulo metropolitan region and the state of Sergipe, while also serving hospitals in São Paulo, Sergipe, Bahia, and João Pessoa. Diaverum Brazil has a team of 1,200 direct employees and 200 contracted nephrologists. The HR team consists of 16 members, with two based at the headquarters and the rest distributed across the clinics. With an average business growth of over 30% per year, the company is currently developing and deploying HR IT systems in a dynamic, flexible, and multidisciplinary environment.

As a key member of the Management Team , you will play a pivotal role in driving the HR strategy, talent development, employee relations, and compliance with local labour laws , ensuring alignment with global HR standards and company goals.

Reporting to the Country Manager Brazil, this role is based in São Paulo (headquarters in the Vila Olímpia neighborhood) and requires between 20% and 40% local travel.

  • Develop and implement a business-driven HR strategy , supporting the organizational structure with leadership.
  • Act as an ambassador and change agent , ensuring that Diaverum’s culture and values are a living reality.
  • Represent HR in the Country Management Team and Brazil in the global HR team , contributing to continuous improvement projects.
  • Be a visible and hands-on partner for senior leaders, managers, and employees.
  • Ensure labour law compliance and provide guidance on employment matters.
  • Equip clinic managers with HR tools to become strong “people managers.”
  • Support in talent acquisition, performance management, compensation, and development .
  • Oversee payroll, contracts, and HR administration .
  • Manage the full employee lifecycle , including recruitment, onboarding, engagement, and performance reviews.
  • Support M&A activities , ensuring a seamless HR operational transition .
  • Lead workforce planning , ensuring talent attraction and retention.
  • Contribute to budget planning and labour efficiency initiatives with Finance and Operations.
  • Measure and report on key HR data to drive decision-making.
  • Develop and implement HR policies and procedures aligned with corporate standards.
  • Ensure HR tools are available and used effectively across the business.
  • Educate managers and employees on HR processes, including creating employee handbooks and onboarding materials.

People & Organizational Development

  • Lead organizational design initiatives with the management team.
  • Drive learning & development, ensuring training programs support business needs.
  • Oversee employee onboarding, ensuring a strong integration into Diaverum’s culture and values.
  • Lead succession planning for key management roles and specialists.
  • Implement the annual performance appraisal process, ensuring clear goal setting and development plans.
  • Support restructuring initiatives to optimize the organization’s effectiveness.
  • Oversee payroll and benefits administration , ensuring compliance and efficiency.
  • Implement a structured annual compensation review process based on market benchmarks and performance.
  • Develop compensation strategies that drive a high-performance culture .

ABOUT YOU

You have 8-10 years of experience in HR across multiple disciplines and a proven track record in leading change within multilevel organizations . Your strong business acumen allows you to align HR strategies with company goals, and you have an in-depth understanding of Brazilian labour law . You have worked in an international environment , and if you have experience in the healthcare industry , that’s a big plus. You hold a university degree in HR, Finance, or a related field , and you are fluent in English . You are comfortable using MS Office and other HR tools to support business operations.

You are a customer-focused HR leader with strong relationship-building skills. You take a hands-on approach , ensuring HR strategies are not only well-designed but also effectively executed. Your communication, listening, and coaching skills allow you to support both employees and managers, creating a positive and productive work environment. As a change agent , you have the ability to lead HR transformations and integration processes, making a real impact on the business. You have a continuous improvement mindset , always striving to optimize processes and enhance the employee experience.

If you have experience in an international company and a background in the healthcare industry , that would be a plus!

If you’re ready to take on a strategic and operational HR leadership role in a fast-paced, global environment , we’d love to hear from you! Apply now or reach out for more details.

At Diaverum, we value diversity and are committed to equal opportunities. We strive to create an inclusive workplace environment for everyone, welcoming applicants regardless of ethnicity, nationality, gender, gender identity, religion, disability, sexual orientation, age, or marital status.

title: DESENVOLVEDOR FRONT-END PLENO
description:
Sobre nós

Somos uma indústria especializada em soluções tecnológicas para a manutenção preditiva em ativos industriais. O objetivo da nossa solução é transformar a indústria, tornando-a mais segura e mais produtiva que ontem. Ao produzirmos os hardwares e softwares da nossa solução, buscamos apresentar aos nossos clientes e parceiros o porquê de sermos referência em soluções eficientes e eficazes para monitoramento, manutenção e performance de ativos.

Além disso, temos orgulho em possuir as certificações das ISOs 9001, 27001, 27018, 27701. Por meio delas, promovemos a organização e a estrutura de nossos processos, resultando em um ambiente de trabalho mais organizado e eficiente, através de uma cultura interna onde os funcionários são incentivados a buscar a excelência em suas atividades, com oportunidades regulares de aprendizado e desenvolvimento profissional.

Conheça mais sobre nós, visite nosso site.

Sobre a equipe na qual você irá atuar

Você fará parte de uma equipe multidisciplinar dedicada ao desenvolvimento de soluções voltadas para manutenção preditiva de ativos industriais, com foco em ferramentas de análise de vibração e diagnóstico de falhas apoiado por inteligência artificial.

Nossa missão é gerar valor para inspetores e analistas por meio de tecnologias que combinam processamento de sinais, modelos de IA e interfaces intuitivas. A equipe é composta por desenvolvedores front-end e back-end, profissionais de QA, gerentes de produto e designers, todos comprometidos com a entrega de uma experiência de usuário eficiente, confiável e impactante.

Trabalhamos em parceria direta com outras equipes de desenvolvimento de software e de pesquisa e inovação, colaborando na evolução contínua da Plataforma Dynamox, que integra diversas funcionalidades voltadas à confiabilidade de ativos industriais.

Atividades do cargo

  • Desenvolver, testar e manter aplicações web front-end, garantindo qualidade, performance e escalabilidade, em colaboração com outros desenvolvedores (front-end, back-end) e profissionais de QA.
  • Interpretar protótipos gráficos e wireframes, trabalhando em conjunto com designers e gerentes de produto para transformar interfaces em experiências funcionais e acessíveis.

  • Gerenciar suas próprias tarefas, atuando com autonomia e responsabilidade dentro de um ambiente ágil e multidisciplinar.
  • Aplicar e disseminar boas práticas de desenvolvimento de software, incluindo padrões de projeto, testes automatizados e versionamento de código.
  • Contribuir para a segurança da informação e privacidade de dados, adotando práticas seguras no desenvolvimento e no uso de dados sensíveis.

Requisitos

  • Experiência com JavaScript, React, HTML e CSS para desenvolvimento de aplicações web.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas modernas de desenvolvimento front-end como Vite ou Webpack.
  • Familiaridade com Git para versionamento de código e trabalho colaborativo.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas como Figma para consultar especificações de layout e estilo de interfaces.
  • Disposição para evolução constante e aprendizado de novas tecnologias.

Desejáveis

  • Experiência com TypeScript em projetos React.
  • Experiência com bibliotecas de componentes UI como Material UI e Styled Components.
  • Familiaridade com bibliotecas de gerenciamento de estado, como React Context, Redux ou similares.
  • Experiência com testes automatizados utilizando ferramentas como Vitest ou Jest.
  • Conhecimento em bibliotecas de visualização de dados como D3, Highcharts, Plotly ou similares.
  • Noções de deploy de aplicações front-end em ambientes de nuvem, como Vercel, AWS ou Google Cloud.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de observabilidade e monitoramento, como Sentry, New Relic, Datadog ou similares.
  • Experiência com CI/CD pipelines, especialmente em ambientes que utilizam GitHub Actions, GitLab CI ou similares.

Formação

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia de Software, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Design de Jogos ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prática com desenvolvimento de software.

Benefícios

title: Data & AI Consultant São Paulo Early Career
description:
Thorogood is an independent, specialized, data and AI consulting firm that works with some of the biggest and best-known companies around the world. We have offices in London, Philadelphia, Boston, Singapore, São Paulo, and Bangalore, and we work as a global unit to service blue chip customers drawing from the consumer goods, pharmaceutical, and financial services sectors, among others. Together, we compete on the basis of our specialism, our people, high quality, and assured delivery.

We help our customers leverage the latest technologies to make timely, data-driven business decisions. Our multi-skilled teams understand the critical interplay of data engineering, data science, and data visualization. We work across these areas to create business-focused, end-to-end technology solutions robust enough to meet enterprise needs. We recognize the importance of environmental sustainability, both in how we work and in the solutions we build for our clients. Our services span strategy, implementation, advanced analytics services, user empowerment, and support.

Additional information about us, our people, what we do, and some of perspectives can be found on our website here:

About the Position

Overview

Our consultants are expected to have a strong interest in business. Understanding our clients’ organizations and industries is key to identifying areas of opportunity for us to help. Similarly, consultants must have excellent listening, writing, and presenting skills, alongside the aptitude and motivation to master multiple data-focused technologies in a fast-moving field. This combination of business, people, and technical skills is essential.

Our Brazil and US entities are managed together under one Thorogood Americas in support of development of our business in the region. Further, we work with customers and colleagues in the US, UK, India, Singapore, and Brazil to provide effective solutions. The ability to work collaboratively and effectively as part of a distributed team is imperative.

Our most successful consultants develop a well-rounded set of skills in each of these areas of business, people, and technology. You’ll do so via a number of opportunities:

  • Comprehensive training: During your first months at Thorogood, experienced consultants will introduce you to the technologies we work with, the industries we serve, and the ways in which we develop our business.
  • Building your core technology skills: We’re the kind of people who learn best by doing. You’ll be working on a team locked onto business value for the customer to develop fast, effective, and high-quality technical solutions.
  • Working with top clients: Thorogood works with some of the biggest and best-known companies in the world. You’ll be a part of client interactions, sometimes leading them, to make sure we’re keeping our projects on track and delivering value to our customers.
  • Developing relationships: We consider ourselves trusted advisors for our clients. We earn this trust through listening carefully, sharing the expertise we have acquired, and helping to progress the objectives within their organizations.
  • Shaping future projects: We are always listening to customers to understand their objectives and needs and working with our consultants to share proposals on how we can help.
  • Working as part of a supportive project team: When safe (with respect to the pandemic), you’ll be working from our offices, with occasional travel externally to client sites. Your project teams will comprise consultants across many levels of experience, working together daily to support one another along the way.
  • Becoming an expert, yourself: Our subject matter experts are not necessarily the most tenured people at Thorogood. In the rapidly changing world of data and analytics, we look to all levels of experience to gain expertise in new technologies and analytical techniques.

In addition to project work, Thorogood consultants run our company. We expect you to contribute here, as well:

  • Helping to grow our business: Interact with current and prospective clients, listen to their needs, and drive business development activities and discussions. Together, we’ll consider the business objectives in conjunction with the technical possibilities in order to understand the opportunities for their organizations.
  • Delivering educationally focused marketing events: Prepare and present informational events for contacts at prospective and current clients.
  • Developing our consultancy: Contribute to recruiting, training, and managing our people.

Additional Benefits

We individually select each of our consultants very carefully through our comprehensive interview and assessment process. We place a great deal of value on consultants’ growth and wellbeing. In addition to a challenging and rewarding career path, Thorogood offers the following benefits:

- Very competitive salary and compensation program

- Company-sponsored health coverage

- Incentive programs

- Opportunities for national and international travel

- Focus on work-life balance

Location and Timing

This position is based in our São Paulo office. Our consultants are currently working in a hybrid model and are expected to live and work in São Paulo-SP, Brazil. The expected start date for this position is January 2026 or July 2026, depending on candidate start date availability.

About You

Qualified candidates must have

  • Fluency in written and spoken English and Portuguese
  • Strong interest in business, people, and technology
  • Strong academic record in a related discipline, including engineering, computer science, mathematics, statistics, business, management, or another business and quantitative-focused field
  • Bachelor’s or Mater's degree with graduation between November 2024 and June 2026.

Candidates must demonstrate effectiveness in

  • Working individually and as part of project teams
  • Maintaining responsibility and accountability for quality and work delivery
  • Client focus and relationship management
  • Time management and priority setting
  • Data awareness and business interest
  • Learning new technologies

- This is an entry-level position; no prior full-time employment experience is required.

- Please do highlight if you have studied or worked with

  • Cloud BI & Analytics technology platforms, e.g. Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform
  • SQL, Python, R, Scala, Spark, or any other programming or statistical programming languages and frameworks
  • Applied mathematics, statistics, probability, machine learning, or artificial intelligence
  • Structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data storage, transformation, or analysis

How to Apply

All stages of the recruitment process will be held in English.

Your application must include both your résumé and a short video describing your interest and ability to succeed in this position, provided entirelyin English . Please submit your application bellow.

Nível de Senioridade na Alice

Na Alice, utilizamos o PQI (Índice de Qualidade do Especialista) para reconhecer sua trajetória. O nível Expert identifica profissionais com maturidade clínica e sólida bagagem acadêmica. O PQI soma pontos através de quatro dimensões:

  • Tempo de Formação: Valorizamos sua experiência prática acumulada.
  • Nível Acadêmico: Pontuação para Mestrado, Doutorado ou Pós‑Doc.
  • Formações Adicionais: Peso para Residência, Título de Especialista, Fellowships e cargos de gestão.
  • Engajamento Acadêmico: Atuação como docente e impacto de publicações (Fator H).

Exemplo de composição para Expert: Um médico com 15 anos de formação, que possua Doutorado, Residência e Título de Especialista, atinge a pontuação necessária para este Tier.

O importante não é um critério isolado, mas o conjunto da sua obra profissional.

Ser o guardião da saúde financeira da empresa, garantindo rentabilidade, liquidez e sustentabilidade do plano estratégico (OV/T).

Gerenciar o departamento financeiro, garantindo o cumprimento dos processos internos e das políticas da empresa. Desenvolver e implementar estratégias financeiras alinhadas ao planejamento estratégico e ao crescimento da incorporadora.

Realizar avaliações financeiras e análises de risco para apoiar decisões de investimento, novos projetos, parcerias e joint ventures.

Avaliar e implementar soluções tecnológicas e automações que otimizem processos financeiros e aumentem eficiência (integrações ERP, bancos, BI, etc.).

Monitorar as condições do mercado imobiliário e tendências econômicas relevantes, ajustando estratégias financeiras conforme o ambiente macroeconômico.

Tesouraria, Caixa e Relação com Bancos

Gerenciar a tesouraria, garantindo fluxo de caixa saudável no curto, médio e longo prazo, tanto consolidado quanto por SPE.

Contabilidade, Fiscal e Governança

Gerenciar o departamento contábil para garantir o cumprimento dos processos internos e o fechamento contábil mensal das empresas do grupo.

FP&A e Performance (Resultado, Orçamento e Caixa)

Garantir a confiabilidade e segurança dos dados financeiros, sendo sponsor de integrações, automações e qualidade de informação.

Manter o orçamento anual atualizado, conduzindo revisões periódicas (forecast) e coordenando as áreas envolvidas (Engenharia, DI, Backoffice, Comercial, etc.) para projeções realistas.

Acompanhar DRE gerencial e fluxo de caixa consolidado e por SPE, explicando variações entre realizado e orçado e propondo planos de ação. Desenvolver e manter modelos financeiros de curto, médio e longo prazo, garantindo consistência com o orçamento aprovado e revisões trimestrais.

Realizar modelagem financeira de novos projetos, analisando viabilidade econômico-financeira, ROI, TIR, payback e impacto no orçamento consolidado.

Acompanhar indicadores operacionais e financeiros dos empreendimentos, conectando físico × financeiro (curva de obras, vendas, repasses, distratos).

Representação, Governança e Relação com Stakeholders

Manter comunicação transparente com acionistas, investidores, bancos e demais stakeholders.

Participar de reuniões de diretoria, comitês e conselho, apresentando relatórios financeiros e análises de risco.

Colaborar com a alta administração na formulação e implementação de estratégias de crescimento (novos mercados, novos produtos, ritmos de lançamentos e obras).

Participar ativamente de decisões estratégicas relacionadas a investimentos, parcerias e desenvolvimento de projetos imobiliários.

Formação em Administração, Economia, Contabilidade, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.

Pós-graduação/MBA em Finanças, Controladoria, Gestão de Negócios ou similar (desejável).

title: Banco de Parceiras(os) | Pessoas consultoras e facilitadoras
description:
Job description

Se você está aqui é porque tem interesse em trabalhar conosco e ficamos muito felizes com isso!

Somos uma organização que gera soluções inovadoras de aprendizagem para pessoas e empresas - queremos promover transformação e atuamos como um ecossistema. Queremos nos conectar com gente boa e boa gente de diferentes contextos, preferências, formações e com muita história pra contar, enriquecendo muito mais o nosso ecossistema.

Em nosso formato de atuação a proposta é que você trabalhe por projeto . Se fizer sentido para ambos os lados, vamos te incluindo em mais projetos ao longo do tempo.

O que isso quer dizer? Que se você está buscando um trabalho flexível, autônomo e com espaço para criar muita coisa legal, aprender e crescer, se joga na teya .

Como funciona esse nosso banco?

Ao se candidatar você entrará para o nosso banco de consultoras/consultores e facilitadoras/facilitadores. Isso significa que você não passará por um processo de seleção logo de cara, e sim quando projetos que encaixem no seu perfil aparecerem.

Quando os projetos aparecem?

Depende da demanda e, assim que chegam, vamos atrás das pessoas certas para compor as equipes. Por isso, é muito importante termos o banco mais diverso e atualizado possível.

Qual perfil estamos buscando?

- Gente boa e boa gente que gosta de aprender e não se prende em caixinhas.

- Pessoas adeptas ao modelo de trabalho por projetos, autônomo e flexível.

- Pessoas de diversas regiões do Brasil e do mundo.

- Pessoas apaixonadas por aprendizagem e pela oportunidade de transformar pessoas e organizações através de projetos.

- Pessoas com experiência neste mercado ou que querem aprender sobre o mundo da aprendizagem corporativa.

Para quem é esse banco?

- É para você que já trabalha com facilitação de temas com consultorias nesse mercado de educação corporativa e deseja fazer parte do ecossistema da teya.

- É para você que é especialista em algum tema e/ou já trabalha no meio acadêmico (professores, mestrandos/doutorandos) e ainda não teve contato com consultoria de educação corporativa, mas quer entrar nesse universo.

- É para você executiva/executivo que fala do seu trabalho em palestras, está em transição de carreira, e quer entrar para esse nosso universo de consultoria de aprendizagem corporativa se tornando falititadora/facilitador teya.


Main responsibilities

O que fazem os consultores e consultoras parceiros da teya:

- São nossas principais parcerias na entrega de transformação e conhecimento em nossos projetos.

- Workshops, palestras, videoaulas, podcasts, curadoria, mentoria, rodas de facilitação e qualquer outro elemento da estratégia de aprendizagem.

- Nos ajudam a pensar e desenhar as melhores soluções para nossos clientes.

- Contribuem com a disseminação de conhecimento dentro do nosso ecossistema.


Requirements and skills

- Se conectar com o propósito da teya de gerar impacto positivo e transformação em contextos pessoais e empresariais através do desenvolvimento de pessoas.

- Não acreditar em treinamento.

- Trazer a diversidade e inclusão em sua lista de valores.

- Ter a certeza de que sempre temos algo a conhecer (ou reciclar), e nunca sabemos pouco demais para nos impedir de compartilhar e ensinar.


Additional information

Ao se cadastrar nesse formulário você entrará para o nosso ecossistema – mesmo se não tivermos um projeto para você logo de cara – e terá acesso a todo o conteúdo que produzimos, e os impactos gerados que compartilhamos, lá na nossa comunidade.

Sua Missão na WMI:

Como nosso Especialista em Abertura de Mercado Hunter , você será o pilar fundamental da nossa expansão na Região Centro Oeste do Brasil . Sua principal missão é identificar, prospectar e qualificar laboratórios de análises clínicas que se encaixem no nosso Perfil de Cliente Ideal (ICP), com foco na introdução do nosso sistema de gestão laboratorial (LIS), o Autolac . Você será o responsável por abrir novos caminhos, criar o elo inicial , despertar o interesse genuíno dos prospects e entregar oportunidades qualificadas para a nossa equipe de vendas.

Responsabilidades Chave:

  • Prospecção Ativa (Hunter) e Mapeamento de Mercado: Conduzir uma prospecção intensiva e estratégica para identificar laboratórios de análises clínicas de alto potencial na Região Centro Oeste.
  • Planejamento e Execução de Rotas: Desenvolver e executar rotas de visitas estratégicas para otimizar tempo, recursos e maximizar a cobertura e o número de contatos qualificados.

  • Apresentação de Overview do Autolac: Em campo, quando necessário para gerar maior interesse e qualificação, apresentar um breve e persuasivo overview do sistema Autolac, destacando seus principais benefícios e como ele pode resolver as dores identificadas.
  • Qualificação de Oportunidades: Assegurar que os leads gerados estejam qualificados, com interesse real em explorar a troca ou adoção de um novo sistema de gestão laboratorial.
  • Transição Estratégica para Vendas: Preparar um dossiê completo de cada oportunidade (incluindo histórico da visita, dores levantadas, decisores envolvidos e nível de interesse) e realizar a transição fluida para o Executivo de Vendas responsável, agendando as próximas etapas.
  • Gestão de CRM: Manter o sistema de CRM (Hubspot) meticulosamente atualizado com todas as atividades de prospecção, qualificação, agendamento e informações dos prospects.
  • Inteligência de Mercado: Coletar e reportar informações valiosas sobre o mercado, concorrência e tendências para apoiar a estratégia comercial.

Requisitos Indispensáveis:

  • Experiência comprovada e sólida em prospecção, desenvolvimento de negócios ou abertura de mercado (perfil "Hunter") em vendas B2B, com foco em geração de oportunidades.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado e experiência no segmento de análises clínicas.
  • Habilidade para realizar um overview consultivo e estratégico do sistema Autolac , compreendendo seus diferenciais e a proposta de valor para laboratórios.
  • Excelente capacidade de comunicação verbal, escuta ativa, persuasão e construção de rapport em visitas presenciais.
  • Pensamento estratégico para planejamento e otimização de rotas e visitas.
  • Resiliência, proatividade, organização e foco na qualidade da qualificação e na entrega de leads.
  • Residência na Região Centro Oeste do Brasil para otimizar o planejamento de rotas e o custo-benefício dos deslocamentos.
  • Possuir veículo próprio e CNH válida (categoria B).
  • Total disponibilidade para viagens constantes pela Região Centro Oeste.
  • Regime de contratação PJ (Pessoa Jurídica).
  • Experiência anterior em laboratórios de apoio, em empresas fornecedoras de equipamentos, insumos ou sistemas de gestão para laboratórios.
  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Marketing, Biomedicina, Bioquímica, Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas da saúde.

title: Engineering Manager, MAAS
description:
Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring an Engineering Manager as we expand the MAAS team . Our mission with MAAS ("Metal as a Service") is to provide the best solution for building and running private bare-metal infrastructure, putting a cloud-style on-demand API in front of physical server provisioning, network configuration, and storage. We are hiring engineering managers with experience in high-quality software development and high-performance team leadership who also have deep familiarity with Linux on physical servers, Linux storage and data center networking capabilities.

The Canonical MAAS team is responsible for delivering our Metal As A Service (MAAS) hyperscale provisioning technology. Ubuntu strives to be the most scalable, cloud ready server distribution and MAAS is our platform to get Ubuntu on bare metal servers. MAAS is a rapidly evolving software stack written in Python and Go. Its components span the entire software stack: from low-level hardware detection and provisioning, to the upper level management web interface, API, and CLI. Our most effective engineers are fluent in all these layers, and able to anticipate the consequences of design and engineering choices elsewhere in a complex distributed system.

Canonical is seeking passionate technical leaders who are eager to drive innovation in one of Canonical's flagship data center products. You will play a key role in reshaping the future of data center technology through open source management platforms. MAAS aims to revolutionize data center management at scale starting from day zero deployment to long term data center expansion and maintenance.

Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop engineers, positively influence team and company culture, facilitate technical delivery, and guide strategy and execution. In addition to these responsibilities, you will be expected to collaborate across engineering. The MAAS team regularly interfaces with teams responsible for cloud-init, LXD, and our public cloud offerings.

The successful candidate will have technical leadership attributes and can demonstrate the ability to solve challenging distributed systems problems.

Location : This is a work-from-anywhere position available in EMEA or the Americas.

What we are looking for in you

  • Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) and a background in Computer Science
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Proven experience delivering software using Python, Golang, or similar languages
  • Experience with Linux system administration (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Familiarity with modern Linux cloud computing technologies, including networking, storage, containers and K8S
  • Technical aptitude for understanding complex distributed systems
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Experience with agile software development methodologies
  • Ability to mentor, develop, and support team members
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long

Nice-to-have skills

  • Typescript using modern web frameworks such as React, Angular, Svelte or Vue
  • Data Center infrastructure management and design

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we\'ve been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

This position combines deep technical expertise in manufacturing processes with strong analytical and communication skills.

  • 5+ years of experience in metalworking / mechanical engineering.
  • Expert knowledge of machining and fabrication processes: turning, milling, CNC machining, EDM, laser/waterjet/plasma cutting, sheet metal processing, welding.
  • Understanding of post-processing methods: polishing, hardening, heat treatment, anodizing, sand/shot blasting, coatings, painting.
  • Knowledge of different materials (metals, plastics, composites) and their processing properties.
  • English level B2+.
  • Customer-oriented mindset and ability to clearly explain technical details.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to work under time pressure.
  • IT-enthusiast, ready to adopt modern tools and software (CAD/CAM, CRM, cloud systems).

Core Technical Expertise

  • Technical drawing interpretation – proficiency 5/5.

  • Coatings and heat treatment – proficiency 3/5.
  • Labor intensity and manufacturability assessment – proficiency 5/5.
  • CAM programming for CNC (SolidWorks, Fusion 360, CypCut) – proficiency 3/5, with readiness for further training.

Work Conditions

  • Full-time remote work (home office).
  • Holiday Calendar: US holidays.
  • Flexible schedule aligned with US Eastern Time.
  • Company-provided desktop PC and monitor.
  • Stable high-speed internet and a comfortable workspace are required.

title: Gerente de Network Design | Foco em Projetos
description:
About The Team

Sobre a Shô

Aqui na Shô, acreditamos que cada membro de nossa equipe é fundamental para o nosso sucesso, e que diversidade de perspectivas e vivências são essenciais para movimentar nosso negócio e impulsionar o nosso propósito de mudar o mundo para melhor.

Fazer parte do nosso time é a oportunidade de se desenvolver dentro de uma cultura de muita agilidade. Se você ama assumir grandes responsabilidades e fazer o que nunca foi feito, a Shô é seu lugar. Aqui você terá grandes desafios, trabalhará em colaboração com um time diverso e contribuirá para o futuro do e-commerce no Brasil, criamos impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.

Modelo de Trabalho

Adotamos um modelo de trabalho híbrido. Esse modelo permite que as pessoas ajustem seu ambiente de trabalho de acordo com suas necessidades pessoais, ao mesmo tempo em que promove a colaboração e interação no escritório.

Qual será a sua missão

Liderar o planejamento de capacidade (CAPEX) e novos projetos estruturantes da malha logística em um ambiente de crescimento acelerado e alta pressão por custo, garantindo escalabilidade, eficiência e resiliência da rede para suportar picos de volume, expansão geográfica e novos modelos operacionais.

Job Description

Como será o seu dia a dia

Capacity Planning & CAPEX

  • Desenvolver planos de capacidade de médio e longo prazo, considerando crescimento orgânico, eventos de pico (campanhas, datas duplas) e evolução do mix de produtos.
  • Liderar o portfólio de investimentos de CAPEX logístico (hubs, sorters, automação leve/pesada, soluções bulky).
  • Construir e defender business cases orientados a custo unitário, payback rápido e escalabilidade.
  • Garantir alinhamento entre capacidade planejada, ramp-up operacional e restrições reais de execução.

Projetos Transformacionais de Rede

  • Liderar projetos estruturantes, como:
    • Desenvolvimento e expansão da malha aérea própria ou dedicada.
    • Desenho de soluções específicas para pacotes bulky e cargas volumosas.
    • Avaliar novos modelos de flow (seller → hub, direct injection, linehaul dedicado).
    • Conduzir pilotos rápidos, testes A/B de rede e rollouts escaláveis.

Network Design & Modelagem

  • Construir e manter modelos de network design considerando custo, SLA, capacidade e resiliência.
  • Simular cenários de pico, crescimento agressivo, mudanças de sort mix e restrições de infraestrutura.
  • Avaliar trade-offs entre CAPEX, OPEX, lead time e cobertura geográfica.

Governança & Interface com Stakeholders

  • Atuar como ponto focal entre operações, finanças, procurement, engenharia, tecnologia e liderança regional/global.
  • Garantir governança dos projetos de CAPEX (priorização, milestones, riscos e orçamento).
  • Preparar e apresentar análises e recomendações para fóruns executivos e comitês de investimento.

Execução & Resultados

  • Acompanhar execução dos projetos até o go-live, garantindo aderência ao desenho aprovado.
  • Medir resultados pós-implementação vs business case (custo por pacote, SLA, utilização de capacidade).
  • Identificar oportunidades contínuas de otimização e reinvestimento.

  • You’re a team player - work cohesively with colleagues from across the organization and be able to inspire a shared vision.

Preferred qualifications

  • Proven experience at a global, pre‑IPO startup
  • Experience building a financial partnerships function in a new geography
  • Experience with Fintech thought leadership

title: Consultor Manutenção Mecânica - secagem
description:
O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027.

Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação.

Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência

Sobre o papel

Garantir que equipamentos e sistemas da sua área de atuação, funcionem de forma eficiente e segura, evitando paradas não programadas e interrupções da produção por manutenções de emergência, através de monitoramento de desempenho e demais indicadores, assegurando custos de manutenção adequados, planos de manutenção eficientes e gestão técnica dos times de manutentores.

Atividades principais

  • Criar e otimizar planos de manutenção preventiva, preditiva e corretiva, dos equipamentos de sua área de atuação, estabelecendo cronogramas de manutenção e garantindo e execução da manutenção com a eficiência necessária evitando quebras e impactos na produção;
  • Monitorar o desempenho dos equipamentos e sistemas, utilizando ferramentas de diagnóstico e análise de dados, identificando padrões de falhas, criando e implementando ações para melhorar a confiabilidade e disponibilidade dos equipamentos;
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com o time de engenharia, produção e segurança, apoiando e executando projetos de melhorias, inovação, modificações e modernização de instalações, máquinas e equipamentos, normas e planos de manutenção, identificando causa raiz, apresentando soluções corretivas e preventivas, evitando recorrências, otimizando custos e aumentando a disponibilidade das máquinas e equipamentos;
  • Treinar e orientar tecnicamente os times de manutenção, nos procedimentos e melhores práticas, promovendo a melhoria contínua das habilidades e conhecimento, bem como, assegurando que o time esteja treinado e capacitado para assumir as atividades de manutenção após o startup da planta, disponibilizando ferramentas, recursos técnicos e humanos para apoiar os fornecedores dos equipamentos e tecnologias;
  • Realizar análise dos modos de falha (FMEA) dos sistemas e equipamentos críticos da área de atuação, realizar análise de falha e aplicar metodologia e ferramentas de engenharia (RCA, FTA, RCM, Ishikawa, etc.).
  • Elaborar escopos de contratação de serviços terceirizados de manutenção, participando ativamente das etapas de negociação e avaliação técnica, assegurando as melhores práticas, custos adequados, qualidade, segurança e a confiabilidade em todo o processo;
  • Participar ativamente do processo de planejamento e execução da Parada Geral da planta, realizando o mapeamento das atividades de manutenção, através de alinhamento com a gerência de produção, mitigando os riscos e impactos gerados, desenvolvendo estratégias e plano de ação, avaliando e desenvolvendo fornecedores e prestadores de serviço, sempre prezando pela segurança e otimização dos custos;
  • Implantar, monitorar e analisar diariamente os indicadores de desempenho da sua área de atuação (Custos, disponibilidade, produtividade, estoque de peças de reposição etc.), viabilizando ajustes no planejamento, procedimentos e nos processos;
  • Auxiliar na gestão dos custos da sua área de atuação, realizando a previsão do orçamento anual de (Spend e Headcount), incluindo custos de peças, mão de obra e outros recursos, assim como, acompanhar mensalmente os custos realizados, alocando corretamente nas contas contábeis, apresentando e validando com o gestor imediato durante as reuniões de análise crítica, visando o cumprimento do orçamento e otimização dos custos;
  • Cumprir, fazer cumprir e promover os padrões de segurança e regulamentações aplicadas às pessoas e aos equipamentos, através da realização de avaliação de riscos e implantação de medidas, alinhas à gestão;
  • Garantir que as atividades de manutenção estejam alinhadas aos objetivos e requisitos da área cliente, através de alinhamento e interação com a área demandante, para entendimento da necessidade e expectativa de prazos e qualidade da entrega;
  • Outras atividades correlatas;
  • Propagar, cumprir e fazer cumprir a política de Meio Ambiente, qualidade, Segurança e Saúde Ocupacional, bem como, a política de ética e Compliance, por todos os colaboradores próprios e terceiros, assegurando o cumprimento da legislação e outros compromissos previstos, em todas as atividades produtos e serviços, incluindo os princípios e critérios das normas e ISOs;

Qualificações

  • Graduação superior em Administração, Engenharias e/ou áreas correlatas;
  • Especialização Manutenção Industrial, Gestão de Projetos, Lean Manufacturing e afins;
  • Conhecimento em Metrologia, Medição de dimensional com Instrumentos;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas dedicados, equipamentos rotativos (redutores, bombas, agitadores, ventiladores);
  • Conhecimento avançado em eq.de processo de sistemas de depuração branqueada, formação, secagem, corte e enfardamento;
  • Conhecimento avançado em eq. específicos da área da Secagem, como prensas de sapata, e secaria flakt;
  • Conhecimento das demais áreas do processo de produção de celulose, pátio de madeira e linha de fibras.

Overview

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

About the Team / Role

This Customer Success Senior Manager will play a central role in steering our long-tail restaurant portfolios, leading regional teams and BPOs, and designing the commercial routines and processes that keep the operation disciplined, scalable, and predictable. Deep familiarity with the food service and delivery-aggregator ecosystem is essential to succeed in this role.

In this role, you\'ll be...

  • A leader of leaders, coaching managers and coordinators while setting a high bar for execution.
  • The regional focal point for your territories, ensuring alignment across Sales, Ops, CRM, and Product.
  • Accountable for the performance of your restaurant portfolio (retention, reactivation, order growth, GMV, cancellations).
  • Accountable for the leadership and performance of your coordinators and account executives.
  • Owner of dashboards, reviews, and actions within your portfolio (WBR/MBR/QBR; target setting; variance analysis; recovery plans).
  • Architect of the operating rhythm (cadences, SOPs, playbooks, QA, and governance) to scale with consistency.
  • Driver of restaurant health: activation, menu and catalog quality, availability/uptime, prep time, SLA adherence, pricing & promo.
  • BPO owner: ramp, capacity planning, QA scorecards, incentive schemes, and continuous improvement.
  • Lifecycle strategist for long-tail: segmentation, scaled communications (WhatsApp/Email/IVR), nudges, and education at scale.
  • Incident commander for portfolio issues (cancellations, spikes, outages), with prevention plans and root-cause discipline.

What We're Looking For

  • A track record of performance turning portfolios around and sustaining results.
  • Deep knowledge of the food/aggregators market and marketplace dynamics.
  • A people-first, results-driven management style; you develop leaders who deliver.
  • An analytical and outcomes-oriented mindset; you turn insight into action.
  • The ability to collaborate across diverse stakeholders and functions.
  • Strong organization and attention to detail, with operational rigor.
  • Proactivity and the ability to anticipate operational needs before they surface.
  • Hands-on experience building functions from the ground up (greenfield or heavy turnaround).
  • Bonus: BPO/vendor management experience

Qualifications

  • 10+ years in Customer Success and/or commercial roles, including team leadership.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, or related field.
  • Fluent English.
  • Demonstrated experience managing coordinators, scaled operations, and cross-functional initiatives.
  • Willingness to travel to key regions as needed.

Competencies

  • Excellent verbal and written communication in English and Portuguese.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple direct reports and priorities with clear expectations and follow-through.
  • Decisive and timely judgment in dynamic, high-stakes environments.
  • Structured problem-solving and root-cause orientation.
  • Stakeholder management and negotiation, balancing short-term needs and long-term health.
  • Coaching and performance management, with clear standards and consequences.

Why You\'ll Love Working at DiDi

We create user value: We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven: We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration: Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone\'s best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity: Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth: We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion: Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

Diversity & Inclusion: Diversity is not a vision of the future or something we wish to have one day, it is a non-negotiable value of who we are. We practice inclusion, plurality, and respect. We count on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works together with HR, leadership and identity groups - 99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Cores, 99Mulheres, and 99Mamães. This part of our journey has been written, there remains a long road before us.

title: R&D Machining Analyst
description:
About the Area

The Manufacturing Engineering Team is the cornerstone of transforming innovation into reality. Made up of skilled professionals with diverse expertise, the team is dedicated to converting designs into high-quality, functional products. Committed to continuous improvement, we collaborate across multiple departments to ensure efficient processes, enhance R&D capabilities, and work closely with production and design teams to optimize schedules and deliveries.

Among the core processes that support our daily operations, machining plays a critical role - enabling everything from rapid prototyping to low-volume production runs. This versatility positions machining as a strategic area for continuous optimization, both internally and in collaboration with our manufacturing partners.

Moreover, machining is also essential to the success of injection molding, as it is the primary method used to manufacture high-precision tooling. As a result, the evolution of both processes is naturally interconnected - and their simultaneous development will be key to expanding Tractian’s industrial capabilities and accelerating innovation across our product lines.

What you will do

As an R&D Machinist, you will play a key role in the manufacture of prototypes and small-batch production of parts associated with the development of new products. During the early stages of development, the engineering team may not always have full visibility into every variable of the process — that’s where your collaboration becomes essential. You will work closely with the team to assess project feasibility, understand technical requirements, and deliver high-quality prototypes as quickly and efficiently as possible.

Your responsibilities will go far beyond machining. You’ll also be expected to engage in a variety of hands-on processes, including welding, component assembly, fixture design, and the ongoing enhancement of both laboratory capabilities and internal workflows. In addition to supporting prototype production, your technical feedback will be vital for improving part designs and increasing the overall quality and reliability of our manufacturing processes. As part of your role, you’ll be expected to modify, assemble, and disassemble injection molds, and continuously contribute to the evolution of the lab - bringing forward new ideas, methods, and improvements that directly support our mission of delivering exceptional IoT solutions to industries around the world.

Responsibilities

  • Produce prototypes and parts on conventional lathe, milling machine, grinder and CNC milling machine, being able to not only operate them but also programing the machining with CAM;
  • Organizing and maintaining of the lab;
  • Maintain the stock of consumables, tools and raw materials reaching out to suppliers when needed;
  • Conference of technical drawings and collaborate with requiring teams;
  • Analyzing and performing simple 3D and 2D drawings on CAD;
  • Update and keep up to date with scheduled events and requests, always notifying the requester to events or changes in the schedule;
  • Assist and further improve development of automated robots;
  • Assist and further improve pneumatic and hydraulic devices integrated with CAM;
  • Verify technical drawings and collaborate with requesting teams to improve documentation.

Requirements

  • Course degree as a Mechanical Technician, Machining Technician, Milling or Lathe CNC programing and operation or correlated areas;
  • Minimum 3 years of experience as machining technician;
  • Knowledge of work safety regulations and principles;
  • Experience with mechanical manufacturing processes, being able to produce advanced parts without supervision;
  • Knowledge in working with special materials such as stainless steel, engineering polymers and hardened materials;
  • Experience with metrology equipments;
  • Basic CAD knowledge, performing simple inspections and drawings;
  • Proficiency in Office Suite (Word and Excel) or G Suite (Google Sheets and Docs).

Bonus points

  • 4th or 5th Axis Machining;
  • Tooling dies and mold machining for injection;
  • Basic English understanding;
  • Experience working with Fusion 360 CAM.

title: Data & AI Consultant – Graduate – São Paulo, Brazil

About Thorogood

Thorogood is an independent, specialized, Data & AI consulting firm that works with some of the biggest and best-known companies around the world. We have offices in London, Philadelphia, Boston, Singapore, São Paulo, and Bangalore, and we work as a global unit to service blue chip customers drawing from data-rich sectors such as consumer goods, pharmaceuticals, insurance, and financial services sectors. Together, we compete on the basis of our specialism, our people, high quality, and assured delivery.

We help our customers leverage the latest technologies to make timely, data-driven business decisions. Our multi-skilled teams understand the critical interplay of data engineering, data science, and data visualization. We work across these areas to create business-focused, end-to-end technology solutions robust enough to meet enterprise needs. We recognize the importance of environmental sustainability, both in how we work and in the solutions we build for our clients. Our services span strategy, implementation, advanced analytics services, user empowerment, and support.

About the Position

Overview

Our team members are expected to have a strong interest in business. Understanding our clients’ organizations and industries is key to identifying areas of opportunity for us to help. Similarly, our people must have excellent listening, writing, and presenting skills, alongside the aptitude and motivation to master multiple data-focused technologies in a fast-moving field. This combination of business, people, and technical skills is essential.

Our Brazil and US entities are managed together under one Thorogood Americas in support of development of our business in the region. Further, we work with colleagues across the US, UK, India, Singapore, and Brazil, and with global customers, to provide effective solutions. The ability to work collaboratively and effectively as part of a distributed team is imperative.

Our most successful consultants develop a well-rounded set of skills in each of these areas of business, people, and technology. You’ll do so via a number of opportunities:

  • Comprehensive training: During your first months at Thorogood, experienced consultants will introduce you to the technologies we work with, the industries we serve, and the ways in which we develop our business. Crucially, we will share how we live our values. When you’ve finished, we’ll plan to integrate you into both internal and client project initiatives.
  • Building your core technology skills: We’re the kind of people who learn best by doing. You’ll be working on a team locked onto business value for the customer to develop fast, effective, and high-quality technical solutions.
  • Working with top clients: Thorogood works with some of the biggest and best-known companies in the world. You’ll be a part of client interactions, sometimes leading them, to make sure we’re keeping our projects on track and delivering value to our customers.
  • Developing relationships: We consider ourselves trusted advisors for our clients. We earn this trust through listening carefully, sharing the expertise we have acquired, and helping to progress the objectives within their organizations.
  • Shaping future projects: We are always listening to customers to understand their objectives and needs and working with our consultants to share proposals on how we can help.
  • Working as part of a supportive project team: You’ll be working from our offices, with occasional travel internally or externally to client sites. Your project teams will comprise consultants across many levels of experience, working together daily to support one another along the way.
  • Becoming an expert, yourself: Our subject matter experts are not necessarily the most tenured people at Thorogood. In the rapidly changing world of Data & AI, we look to all levels of experience to gain expertise in new technologies and analytical techniques.

In addition to project work, Thorogood consultants run our company, thus it’s expected from them:

  • Help to grow our business: Interact with current and prospective clients, listen to their needs, and drive business development activities and discussions. Together, we’ll consider the business objectives in conjunction with the technical possibilities in order to understand the opportunities for their organizations.
  • Deliver educationally focused marketing events: Prepare and present informational events for contacts at prospective and current clients.
  • Develop our consultancy: Contribute to recruiting, training, and managing our people.

Additional Benefits

We individually select each of our consultants very carefully through our comprehensive interview and assessment process. We place a great deal of value on consultants’ growth and wellbeing. In addition to a challenging and rewarding career path, Thorogood offers the following benefits:

  • Very competitive salary and compensation program
  • Company-sponsored health coverage
  • Incentive programs
  • Opportunities for national and international travel
  • Focus on work-life balance

Location and Timing

This position is based in our São Paulo office. Our consultants are currently working in a hybrid model and are expected to work in São Paulo-SP, Brazil. The expected start date for this position is January 2026 or July 2026, depending on candidate start date availability.

About You

Qualified candidates must have:

  • Fluency in written and spoken English and Portuguese
  • Strong interest in business, people, and technology
  • Strong academic record in a related discipline, including engineering, computer science, mathematics, statistics, business, management, or another business and quantitative-focused field
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with graduation between November 2024 and June 2026

Candidates must demonstrate effectiveness in:

  • Working individually and as part of project teams
  • Maintaining responsibility and accountability for quality and work delivery
  • Client focus and relationship management
  • Time management and priority setting
  • Data awareness and business interest
  • Learning new technologies

This is an entry-level position; no prior full-time employment experience is required . Please do highlight if you have studied or worked with:

  • Cloud Data & AI technology platforms, e.g. Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform
  • SQL, Python, R, Scala, Spark, or any other programming or statistical programming languages and frameworks
  • Applied mathematics, statistics, probability, machine learning, or artificial intelligence
  • Structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data storage, transformation, or analysis

How to Apply

All stages of the recruitment process will be held in English.
Your application must include both your résumé and a short video describing your interest and ability to succeed in this position, provided entirely in English . Please submit your application here .

title: Mobile Engineering Manager
description:
About Nubank’s Mobile Platform and App Core

The Mobile Platform’s mission aligns with Nubank’s commitment to delivering the best experience for our customers by ensuring a high-performing, stable, and seamless app.
Within Mobile Platform, App Core focuses on providing user-friendly, scalable, high-performing, and cost-efficient app infrastructure components and mobile tools that enable Nubank engineers to quickly and safely test, deploy, monitor, analyze, and improve app flows and features.

App Core is at the heart of the Nubank app’s foundation, powering app performance, infrastructure scalability, and the removal of legacy dependencies to allow our application to grow from millions to potentially billions of fanatic customers.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the App Core squad — a cross-impact engineering team responsible for building and maintaining the core mobile app infrastructure, optimizing performance, and enabling product teams to deliver high-quality mobile experiences.

This is a strategic leadership role requiring a strong technical foundation, excellent people management skills, and the ability to align execution with Nubank’s long-term mobile strategy. You will guide the team to eliminate bottlenecks, improve app startup time, reduce native dependencies, and drive infrastructure modernization , all while fostering a culture of high performance and collaboration.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead and Grow the AppCore Team Build, mentor, and inspire a high-performing team of mobile engineers, fostering technical excellence, ownership, and innovation.
  • Set Vision and Strategy Define and drive the AppCore roadmap in alignment with Mobile Platform’s mission and Nubank’s two-year engineering vision — including initiatives like achieving sub-500ms “App Ready to Use” startup times.
  • Ensure Technical Excellence Oversee the design, development, and maintenance of scalable app infrastructure components and tools, ensuring performance, reliability, and cost efficiency.
  • Cross-Team Collaboration Partner with Product Engineering squads to enable faster and safer delivery of mobile features, guiding them in best practices for mobile architecture, performance optimization, instrumentation, and observability.
  • Drive Performance Improvements Lead efforts to reduce app startup time, optimize critical paths, migrate core systems, and remove legacy/native dependencies.
  • Operational Leadership Ensure the adoption and effective use of internal mobile tools, such as monitoring (Prometheus, Honeycomb), error tracking (Sentry), and performance profiling.
  • Stakeholder Management Collaborate closely with leaders across engineering, product, and design to align priorities, balance trade-offs, and remove roadblocks.

What We’re Looking For

Must Have:

  • Proven experience managing mobile engineering teams or senior-level technical leadership in mobile development.
  • Strong technical background with Flutter and/or native mobile development (Android/iOS).
  • Solid understanding of mobile software engineering principles, architectural patterns, and modularization strategies.
  • Experience with performance optimization, dependency injection, and migration of core systems.
  • Knowledge of mobile observability, monitoring, and debugging tools.
  • Strong communication skills in English, with the ability to explain complex concepts to diverse audiences.
  • Track record of delivering results in ambiguous, fast-paced environments.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with backend technologies, especially those integrated with mobile applications.
  • Familiarity with distributed systems and large-scale app architecture.
  • Contributions to internal SDKs, libraries, or mobile design systems.
  • Understanding of user authentication, session management, and app state handling.
  • Experience leading cross-functional or cross-impact engineering initiatives.

Why Join Us

  • Impact at Scale: Help shape the mobile experience for millions of customers across multiple countries, with the goal of reaching billions.
  • Technical Leadership: Influence the architecture and foundational technologies that all Nubank engineers rely on.
  • Innovation-Driven Culture: Work in a dynamic, collaborative environment that values experimentation, continuous improvement, and engineering excellence.
  • Career Growth: Develop as a strategic engineering leader, working on complex technical and organizational challenges.

description:
Assistente de Distribuição e Logística - Boa Vista/RR

ASSOCIACAO VOLUNTARIOS PARA O SERVICO INTERNACIONAL - BRASIL

CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO:

AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana. Nos últimos anos, a Venezuela tem vivido uma forte crise, ocasionando vulnerabilidade social e um contexto de emergência humanitária que se concretiza em uma intensa migração em território brasileiro. Em 2018, como resposta a essa demanda, o Governo Federal estruturou a Operação Acolhida cujo objetivo é garantir atendimento aos refugiados e migrantes venezuelanos. A operação consiste em uma série de estratégias de regularização documental, imunização, acolhimento e realocação voluntária dessas pessoas, em situação de vulnerabilidade, dos municípios de Roraima para outras cidades do Brasil. A AVSI Brasil integra a resposta federal à emergência humanitária venezuelana da Operação Acolhida, e neste contexto formalizou um Termo de Colaboração com o Ministério do Desenvolvimento Social (MDS) para a atuar em 4 (quatro) centros de acolhida (abrigos) para refugiados e migrantes venezuelanos na cidade de Boa Vista, em Roraima.

DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO:

O(a) Assistente de Distribuição e Logística responde ao(à) Coordenador de Abrigo. É responsável pela área de logística e distribuição de itens não alimentares e alimentares no abrigo, levantando as necessidades, organizando e realizando distribuições de itens alimentares e não alimentares de acordo com as metodologias e diretrizes fornecidas, prestando contas aos doadores das entregas realizadas. Deve garantir um processo equitativo, sistemático e de comunicação efetiva. Ainda, monitora as questões de infraestrutura do abrigo, fazendo as devidas comunicações e referenciamentos. Trabalha em estreita colaboração com o(a) Oficial de Distribuição e Logística, com a Força Tarefa Logística e Humanitária (FT Log Hum), sociedade civil e outros parceiros da Operação Acolhida atuando nessa área.

Responsabilidades

  • Distribuição e Logística – Realizar o levantamento da necessidade de materiais do abrigo (pedidos internos), bem como proceder ao pedido de materiais, de acordo com a periodicidade estabelecida.
  • Realizar o levantamento das necessidades de itens não alimentares (NFIs) no abrigo, e encaminhar os pedidos de acordo com periodicidade estabelecida.
  • Receber e organizar materiais e doações de NFIs, organizando o estoque, e seguindo a metodologia dos doadores para recebimento de NFIs.
  • Manter atualizado o estoque de materiais e NFIs do abrigo; manter atualizado o inventário de bens e materiais do abrigo.
  • Fazer o controle de entradas e saídas de materiais e NFIs do estoque.
  • Manter o depósito / espaço de depósito organizado, de forma a garantir o padrão de qualidade no armazenamento.
  • Coordenar e realizar a distribuição de itens não-alimentares, organizando o material, mobilizando a equipe, mantendo a comunidade informada, e liderando a distribuição na data e critérios estabelecidos.
  • Distribuir regularmente materiais aos comitês, para atividades de manutenção e limpeza do abrigo, e monitorar o uso desses materiais.
  • Manter mecanismos efetivos de comunicação com a comunidade sobre as distribuições de itens não-alimentares, com informações antecipadas (mínimo de 3 dias de antecedência) do que será distribuído, critérios, horários.
  • Buscar ativamente o engajamento da população sobre como melhorar os procedimentos de distribuição.
  • Realizar levantamentos de materiais e de NFIs ad hoc, sempre que solicitado pelo doador, gerência do projeto e/ou supervisor(a).
  • Participar, sempre que solicitado, de reuniões com ACNUR e outros parceiros da Operação que realizam doações de itens não-alimentares.
  • Infraestrutura – Compreender a infraestrutura local do abrigo, e estar atento aos possíveis danos, necessidades ou pontos de possíveis melhorias.
  • Monitorar e identificar problemas de infraestrutura e responder a: 1) pequenos reparos: mobilizar e supervisionar o comitê de infraestrutura; demandas maiores: encaminhamento à equipe de infraestrutura da organização e reporte ao ACNUR de acordo com metodologia definida.
  • Coordenar com Força Tarefa Log Hum (equipe interna ao abrigo) para respostas às demandas de infraestrutura.
  • Outras tarefas que possam ser atribuídas pelo supervisor(a), Oficial de Distribuição e Logística ou gerência do projeto, necessárias a total implementação do programa do ACNUR no local.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring Python and Kubernetes Specialist Engineers focused on Data, AI/ML and Analytics Solutions to join our teams building open source solutions for public cloud and private infrastructure.
As a software engineer on the team, you'll collaborate on an end-to-end data analytics and mlops solution composed of popular, open-source, machine learning tools, such as Kubeflow, MLFlow, DVC, and Feast. You may also work on workflow, ETL, data governance and visualization tools like Apache SuperSet, dbt, and Temporal, or data warehouse solutions such as Apache Trino, or ClickHouse. Your team will own a solution from the analytics and machine learning space, and integrate with the solutions from other teams to build the world's best end-to-end data platform. These solutions may be run on servers or on the cloud, on machines or on Kubernetes, on developer desktops, or as web services.
We serve the needs of individuals and community members as much as the needs of our Global 2000 and Fortune 500 customers; we make our primary work available free of charge and our Pro subscriptions are also available to individuals for personal use at no cost. Our goal is to enable more people to enjoy the benefits of open source, regardless of their circumstances.
Location: This initiative spans many teams that are home-based and in multiple time zones. We believe in distributed collaboration but we also try to ensure that colleagues have company during their work hourse! Successful candidates will join a team where most members and your manager are broadly in the same time zone so that you have the benefits of constant collaboration and discussion.
What your day will look like

  • Develop your understanding of the entire Linux stack, from kernel, networking, and storage, to the application layer
  • Design, build and maintain solutions that will be deployed on public and private clouds and local workstations
  • Master distributed systems concepts such as observability, identity, tracing
  • Work with both Kubernetes and machine-oriented open source applications
  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team of engineers, designers and product managers
  • Debug issues and interact in public with upstream and Ubuntu communities
  • Generate and discuss ideas, and collaborate on finding good solutions

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university

  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results

  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)

  • Appreciative of diversity, polite and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organisation

  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long

  • Hands-on experience with machine learning libraries, or tools.
  • Proven track record of building highly automated machine learning solutions for the cloud.
  • Experience with container technologies (Docker, LXD, Kubernetes, etc.)
  • Experience with public clouds (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
  • Working knowledge of cloud computing
  • Passionate about software quality and testing

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Excellent Python skills are a key requirement, with previous contributions to open source Python projects being an advantage. The Pro client often interacts with the Ubuntu package management; therefore, experience in configuring apt, and knowledge of deb packaging and general system administration is advantageous in this role.
Applicants should be passionate about the Ubuntu project and its values and about building tools that are used by millions of people around the world. A personal interest and emphasis on quality, thinking of edge cases, ease of use, documentation, and careful community coordination is important. The Pro client is used at all ranges, from mission-critical environments to hobbyist Ubuntu users; applicants should be ready to work with the whole spectrum of end users and help guide engineering best practices with all of them in mind.

description:
