Join to apply for the Developer Relations Engineer role at Canonical

2 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Developer Relations Engineer role at Canonical

As the publisher of Ubuntu we serve millions of developers, building for the cloud, IoT and data science. We aim to make open source easier and more reliable for innovators and enterprises.
We have created a new Developer Relations team to engage directly with open source communities and developer-centric organisations. We hope both to communicate our vision and products for better open source development experiences, and also to have a better feedback loop from those audiences to shape our offerings and priorities.
A Developer Relations Engineer is a technical expert, strategist and communicator with deep empathy for developers. This discipline combines practical engineering skills with firm diplomacy across organisational boundaries, in both directions. Like our audience, a Developer Relations Engineer is never satisfied with the status quo, and is driven by an insatiable curiosity to find better ways to get things done. They are problem-solvers and inventors, who understand people's needs and love the way that tools can be adapted to meet them. They stay current with tech trends and provide insights and guidance while fostering innovation.
To improve your chances of success in this application, read our advice on how to get a job at Canonical.
Location : we are building our initial DevRel team in Europe, Middle East, African and American time zones
What your day will look like
In a typical day, a developer relations engineer might:

  • take part in team product meetings, at levels from strategy to day-by-day development progress, contributing insight and expertise
  • maintain conversations with developer community members wherever they may be found - IRC, social media, product forums, meet-ups and more
  • work with colleagues in other teams in the company, as part of efforts to help establish commonality and consistent approaches
  • help solve specific technical problems that users or colleagues have identified
  • contribute to technical documentation to ensure that developer users' needs are met there
  • work on technical articles, presentations or workshops
  • identify new opportunities and directions for improvement in the developer experience we provide
  • present at conferences, meetups or technical events
What we are looking for in you
A strong candidate
  • is a programmer or developer with a demonstrable passion for and engagement in open-source software
  • has worked with real-world challenges developing and deploying software using Linux
  • has practical hands-on experience of Linux software packaging (including Snaps, debs, charms, rocks, PIP, containers)
  • understands current software packing issues and trends in the Linux ecosystem
  • has been a contributor to open-source communities, software and documentation
  • is an engaging, vivacious speaker and presenter
  • can work effectively, tactfully, empathetically and confidently in contexts where different parties have different perspectives, needs and understanding
  • builds trust, relationships and confidence
  • is willing to travel globally twice a year for company events, as well as to upstream and partner events
Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring
  • previous experience in a developer advocacy or community role
  • in-depth familiarity with Ubuntu and the Canonical ecosystem of products
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.
Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Essa visão se fortalece em nosso manifesto cultural, no qual afirmamos: somos um time colaborativo e persistente na busca de soluções, transformando desafios em resultados extraordinários através de execução ágil, versátil e austera, sempre guiados por integridade, responsabilidade e aprendizado contínuo.

É nesse contexto que buscamos profissionais para compor nosso time, contribuindo para o crescimento sustentável e para a entrega de valor em cada desafio.

Estamos em busca de Gerente Geral responsável pela administração e operação do shopping center em todas as suas áreas, desde a supervisão das operações diárias até a implementação de estratégias comerciais e financeiras para maximizar sua rentabilidade.

Responsabilidades

Gestão Operacional: Supervisionar o funcionamento diário do shopping, incluindo financeiro, comercial, marketing, operações, limpeza, segurança, manutenção e serviços gerais.

Relacionamento com Lojistas: Manter uma boa comunicação com os lojistas e fornecedores, garantindo que as operações estejam alinhadas e que o shopping ofereça uma boa experiência para os consumidores e para os lojistas.

Gestão de Equipe: Gerenciar as equipes internas de operações, financeiro, marketing e comercial garantindo que todos estejam treinados e alinhados aos objetivos do shopping.

Planejamento e Estratégia: Desenvolver estratégias de vendas, marketing e promoções para atrair clientes e aumentar o fluxo de pessoas no shopping.

Gestão Financeira: Controlar o orçamento do shopping, realizando planejamento financeiro, controle de receitas e despesas, além de analisar relatórios financeiros para garantir a saúde econômica do centro comercial.

Experiência do Cliente: Garantir que a experiência do cliente seja positiva, implementando melhorias baseadas no feedback dos consumidores e trabalhando para resolver qualquer problema que surja.

Gestão de Infraestrutura e Inovações: Coordenar a manutenção da infraestrutura do shopping e, em alguns casos, implementar inovações tecnológicas.

  • Formação superior em Administração, Gestão de Negócios, Marketing ou áreas correlatas.

  • Habilidade em gestão financeira e comercial de equipes multidisciplinares.
  • Inconformismo, tenacidade, visão estratégica e foco em resultados.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, negociação e relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão e análise de desempenho.

title: IP Network Team Lead
description:
1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider dedicated to empowering enterprises worldwide to unlock the full growth potential of mobile connectivity. With a best-in-class telecom technology platform, a comprehensive suite of globally viable regulatory licenses, and privileged access to the telecom wholesale market, 1GLOBAL is uniquely positioned to deliver seamless compliance and connectivity solutions. Serving the world’s leading banks, corporations, and digital-first businesses—including neo-banks, travel companies, and payment service providers—1GLOBAL connects over 43 million devices globally.

With 2024 full-year revenue exceeding US$100 million and in line to exceed US$200 million in FY25, 1GLOBAL is a profitable business generating significant cash flows to fund its ongoing investments in infrastructure, transformation, and growth. 2024 saw major client wins and marked 1GLOBAL’s evolution from a multi-market telecommunication provider to a global technology-driven mobile connectivity powerhouse.

Established in 2022 by experienced tech founders and entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL is a European technology leader driving digital transformation in the global telecommunications market. It operates as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (“MVNO”) in ten countries and as a regulated telecommunications operator in an additional 31 countries. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 450 experts across 15 countries.

Position Overview

We are looking for a talented and drivenIP Networks Team Lead to join our Technology Department.

We are open to hiring this role in São Paulo, Brazil.

As the IP Networks Team Lead, you will be responsible for designing, operating, and evolving ourglobal IP backbone and data center networks , ensuring they arescalable, secure, and highly available. This role blendstechnical leadership and hands-on engineering , guiding the team in building and maintaining next-generation network infrastructure across our on-prem and cloud environments.

You will act as both atechnical authorityandpeople leader , responsible for defining network architecture standards, enforcing best practices, and managing priorities across multiple initiatives.

Your mission is to deliver a world-class network foundation supporting global mobile, cloud, and connectivity services.

Fluency in English is essential for this role.

Please ensure your CV is submitted in English as part of your application.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of network engineers, managing performance, priorities, and technical direction.
  • Design, implement, and maintain LAN, WAN, data center, and backbone network infrastructure.
  • Architect and operate high-availability global IP networks interconnecting data centers and cloud regions.
  • Ensure network redundancy and resilience testing across service, infrastructure, and transport layers.
  • Plan and oversee SDN and SD-WAN to enable automation and dynamic traffic engineering.
  • Deploy and manage routers, switches, and firewalls.
  • Implement and maintain IPv6, QoS, and traffic-engineering policies to guarantee consistent network performance.
  • Monitor network health, performance, and capacity, ensuring high availability, low latency, and reliability.
  • Investigate complex network incidents, lead root-cause analysis, and ensure follow-up actions are implemented.
  • Ensure network security and compliance with internal policies and industry standards (ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, CIS).
  • Automate network provisioning, configuration, and monitoring using Terraform, Ansible, or similar tools.
  • Continuously improve observability and visibility using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and SNMP-based systems.
  • Support migrations, upgrades, and expansions while minimizing downtime and risk.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of configurations, topology diagrams, and operational procedures.
  • Generate regular network performance and incident reports with actionable recommendations.
  • Experience: 10+ years as an IP/Networking Engineer, with expertise in designing, deploying, and managing high-availability, scalable intercontinental networks (including at least 2+ years in a leadership role).
  • Mobile IP Networks & Backhaul: Extensive experience designing and managing IP-based mobile backhaul networks for 4G/5G, ensuring seamless delivery of traffic, data, and voice services.
  • SD-WAN & SDN: Proven expertise with SD-WAN and SDN technologies like Cisco ACI or NDFC, enabling network automation and optimization of global IP backbones.
  • IPv6 & QoS: Strong experience with IPv6 deployment and QoS configuration to optimize bandwidth and ensure high-performance, reliable connectivity.
  • Data Center & Backbone Design: Skilled in designing and managing global IP backbones and interconnected data centers for high-performance, low-latency connections.
  • Advanced Network Protocols: Expert-level knowledge in TCP/IP stack, including TCP, UDP, ICMP, SMTP, SNMP, LDAP, DNS, NTP, and other essential protocols. Proficient in dynamic routing protocols like BGP, OSPF, and MPLS.
  • Network Security & Compliance: Expertise in IPSec VPNs, security hardening, and compliance frameworks (PCI-DSS, ISO27001, CIS).
  • Layer 2 & Layer 3 Management: Hands-on experience managing Layer 2 (STP, MSTP) and Layer 3 multiservice networks with MPLS and traffic engineering.
  • Network Automation & IaC: Proficient in Terraform, Ansible, and other tools to automate network provisioning and streamline deployments.
  • Network Monitoring & Observability: Expertise in tools like Prometheus, Grafana, SNMP, and Wireshark for network monitoring and performance optimization.
  • High-Performance Networking: Proven ability to design and optimize solutions for WAN optimization, traffic engineering, and latency reduction.
  • Leadership & Collaboration: Strong leadership skills in mentoring engineers, driving network strategy, and collaborating with cross-functional teams.

Nice to Have

  • Knowledge ofPythonfor network automation, data collection, or tooling development.
  • Hands-on experience with redundancy validation, chaos testing, or network failover simulation.
  • Familiarity with multi-cloud networking and hybrid-connectivity architectures.
  • Experience integrating network telemetry into performance and reliability dashboards.
  • Experience collaborating with global carriers, IXPs, and data center providers.

What we offer?

  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card —R$100 per working day
  • Extended parental leave — 180 days of maternity leave and 20 days of paternity leave.
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica —50% covered by the company
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old —R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)!

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

Sua atuação terá visibilidade para a alta liderança da companhia e irá se reportar diretamente para o CRO da Conta Azul. Terá impacto direto no crescimento da companhia com resultados ainda em 2025, podendo se tornar um importante canal de receita, com oportunidades claras de crescimento de carreira e potencial liderança com estruturação de um time especializado.

Será necessário aprendizado e entendimento profundo de modelos de franquia e licenciamento, pois esse será o seu principal nicho de atuação inicialmente. Você será responsável por desenvolver negócios e fazer as primeiras vendas para grupos econômicos que tem a necessidade de apurar o resultado financeiro consolidado e que atuam com rede de franqueados / licenciados (PMEs). Este é um nicho ainda não explorado pela Conta Azul, apesar de já termos validado essa oportunidade de mercado.

A Conta Azul é movida pela crença que todo empreendedor merece ter sucesso. Apesar do dia a dia cheio de responsabilidades, queremos que todo dono de um pequeno negócio consiga tempo para se dedicar ao que sempre sonhou quando decidiu abrir uma empresa. Por isso, usamos a tecnologia para criar uma plataforma em nuvem, onde o empreendedor juntamente com o seu contador, de forma simples e fácil, podem encontrar tudo o que precisam em tempo real.   • Trabalhar com áreas de RevOps e Pricing para montar propostas comerciais.
  • Alimentar CRM com dados estruturados e gerar insights de canal e reportar semanalmente aprendizados, gargalos e potenciais para escala.
  • Estabelecer relações comerciais duradouras com foco em geração de valor mútuo.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Capacidade de gerar interesse e marcar reuniões com decisores a partir do zero.
  • Habilidade para mapear segmentos, qualificar leads e interpretar padrões de comportamento. Utiliza dados de forma inteligente e sistemática. Faz leitura de dados para construir soluções e tomar as decisões. Acompanha métricas e entende seus reflexos nas estratégias, planos e resultados. Utiliza-se de analises para traduzir contextos.
  • Capacidade de compreender o mercado em que a Conta Azul está inserida, soluções do ERP e as dores dos principais segmentos. Entendimento básico das estruturas operacionais e jurídicas de modelos de franquias e licenciamento.
  • Fluência no uso de ferramentas para gerir pipeline e registrar interações com leads.
  • Capacidade de comunicar ideias com clareza, escutar ativamente e construir relações de confiança com diferentes stakeholders. Inclui habilidade de conduzir negociações complexas, alinhando interesses diversos e gerando acordos mutuamente vantajosos
  • Capacidade de agir com iniciativa, senso de dono e proatividade. Implica não apenas propor soluções, mas liderar sua implementação com foco em impacto e resultados ganha ganha, mesmo diante de incertezas ou recursos limitados
  • Transitar bem entre áreas internas (produto, jurídico, marketing, vendas, finanças) para que tenha sucesso na implementação das novas negociações e garanta as amarrações das negociações e pontos chave de contato para o novo cliente.
  • Disposição para aprender rapidamente sobre os modelos de negócio dos prospects.
  • Orientação a metas, com aprendizado contínuo e ajustes táticos conforme necessário.
  • Além do olhar de crescimento, ter a responsabilidade pelo impacto gerado, considerando implicações de longo prazo para o negócio, os parceiros e os clientes. Agir como dono das iniciativas e dos resultados. Priorizr crescimento sustentável, não apenas números de curto prazo e assumir erros e corrige rapidamente com aprendizado.
  • Compreensão de indicadores como LTV, CAC, NMRR, e lógica de canais indiretos.
  • Habilidade de se comunicar com fluência em inglês. Preparar materiais, realizar benchmarks internacionais. Comunica-se com objetividade e clareza utilizando o idioma. Tem facilidade para conduzir reuniões, benchmarks e discussões em inglês. Consome materiais em inglês e tem habilidade de produzir documentos e materiais no idioma.
  • Conhecimento em plataformas que aumentam produtividade em cadências de contato.
  • Ter experiência em venda de software para franqueadores e/ou licenciadores.
  • MBA ou especialização em áreas correlatas (negócios, estratégia, inovação, etc.).
  • Experiência comprovada +3 anos com desenvolvimento de negócios, parcerias ou expansão de mercado (Preferencialmente ter vendido software para licenciadores e franquadores)

As a Sales Engineering Delivery Manager, you will serve as the crucial link between our prospective clients and internal teams. In this role, you will lead technical discovery sessions and consultative introduction calls, gather essential engagement details (such as timelines, budgets, skillset requirements, risks, and SWOT analyses), and translate these insights into impactful proposals.   • Technical Discovery Call & Stakeholder Engagement: Assemble Sales Support Engineering team, align them on preliminary information, following internal RACI procedures; Lead the Technical Discovery call, showcasing interpersonal skills to build rapport and trust quickly; Demonstrate in-depth knowledge of the SDLC—from ideation and inception through discovery and development to market release; Use consultative questioning to uncover client pain points and business objectives, extracting and analyzing high-level requirements (timeline, budget, skill needs, risk); Present clear, persuasive client-facing communications during calls and emails.

  • Exceptional Communication & Soft Skills: outstanding interpersonal skills with the ability to build rapport and trust quickly; strong presentation and storytelling abilities for clear client-facing communication.
  • UX & Presentation Design Acumen: solid grasp of user experience (UX) principles and design thinking; proven track record of creating high-quality, visually engaging presentation decks and proposals.
  • Technical Savvy & SDLC Knowledge: deep understanding of the software development lifecycle—from conceptualization through market release—and familiarity with agile methodologies; ability to discuss technical nuances without losing sight of business impact.
  • Analytical & Strategic Thinking: strong analytical skills to synthesize complex information, identify key insights, and recommend actionable strategies; ability to prioritize client objectives while balancing technical feasibility and business goals.
  • Team Collaboration & Cross-Functional Coordination: demonstrated ability to work across multiple departments, managing internal communications as deals move from funnel to kickoff; ability to serve as a liaison across Sales, Engineering, and Recruiting.

title: Senior Backend Software Engineer
description:
Overview

TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients. As part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

Engineering at TRACTIAN: the Backend Engineering team builds and scales the infrastructure powering our platform, from advanced monitoring products to our CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management System). We design and develop robust systems that handle large volumes of real-time and historical data from industrial assets.

We craft and maintain data-intensive microservices, resilient APIs, and scalable ETL pipelines. Our work spans relational and non-relational database schemas, event-driven architectures, and performance optimization under high-throughput workloads. Backend Engineers work with firmware, frontend, data, and product teams to deliver features that improve equipment reliability, reduce downtime, and modernize industrial operations.

What you’ll do as a Backend Software Engineer: design and build critical APIs, microservices, and ETLs powering our core products, from industrial monitoring systems to our CMMS platform. You’ll evolve backend architecture to meet scale, performance, and product-excellence demands, directly impacting thousands of users across industries that rely on us to keep operations running.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain data-intensive, high-performance backend services based on an event-driven architecture.
  • Develop and maintain APIs and services that power real-time monitoring features and complex maintenance workflows.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure backend applications align with the overall product vision and user experience goals.
  • Optimize applications and data processing workflows for performance, speed, efficiency, and reliability across environments.
  • Continuously evolve systems through refactoring, introducing best practices, and improving maintainability and observability.
  • Document architectural decisions and technical implementations for current and future maintainers.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field
  • 5+ years of backend development experience with a focus on user-facing products
  • Experience with event-driven applications using messaging technologies like Kafka, RabbitMQ, BullMQ or similar
  • Strong programming skills in Go, Python, Node.js, and/or Rust
  • Deep understanding of microservices architecture and distributed system design
  • Proficiency with relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, ClickHouse) and non-relational databases (e.g., ScyllaDB, Cassandra, MongoDB) with focus on performance and scalability
  • Experience building mission-critical backend services in high-growth, product-driven environments

Bonus points

  • Contributions to open-source or personal projects demonstrating backend architecture or data processing expertise
  • Fluency in English

Compensation

  • Competitive salary and stock options
  • Optional fully funded English / Spanish courses
  • 30 days of paid annual leave
  • Education and courses stipend
  • Employee Giving
  • Earn a trip anywhere in the world every 4 years
  • Up to R$1,000/mo for meals and remote work allowance
  • Health plan with national coverage and without coparticipation
  • Dental Insurance for improved quality of life
  • Gympass and Sports Incentive: R$300/mo extra if you practice activities

Seniority level

  • Mid-Senior level

Employment type

  • Full-time

Job function

  • Engineering and Information Technology
  • Software Development

This role reports to the Senior Director of Engineering.
